title: ADHD vs Non-ADHD Telling a Story 😂 Forgetting What I Was Saying #shorts
desc:
ADHD forgetting what I was saying, in real time.

Started a story about a dog. Ended up on the moon landing. Never got back to the dog. 😂 Ever lose your story halfway? 👇

Tip: say the ending first, then tell the rest.

#adhd #adhdlife #adhdbrain #adhdproblems #adhdhumor #shorts #relatable #funny
tags: adhd forgetting what i was saying
what it's like to have adhd

beats.say: Here's how a normal person tells a story. Beginning. Middle. End. Everybody laughs.
beats.label: NON-ADHD:

beats.say: Now here's me. Okay, so this morning I saw a dog at the gas station.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: So I saw a dog at the gas station...

beats.say: Gas is so high right now, by the way. Did you know they used to put lead in gas?
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: Did you know they put LEAD in gas?

beats.say: Which reminds me of my uncle's old truck. That truck went everywhere. It went to Florida.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: My uncle's truck went to Florida.

beats.say: Florida is where they launch the rockets. Did you know the moon is moving away from us?
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: The moon is moving AWAY from us??

beats.say: Wait. What was I saying? How did we get to the moon?
beats.label: ADHD:

beats.say: There was a dog. That's all I know. The dog was the whole story.
beats.label: ADHD:
beats.cap: There was a dog. That's it.

beats.say: Here's why. An ADHD brain links every thought to three more, and the newest one wins. Try saying the ending first. Then the side trips can't steal it.
Ever lose your story halfway through? Tell me where you ended up in the comments.
beats.cap: Where did YOUR story end up?
